Name: Willy sells Loved Fish
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[b]Willy sells Loved Fish[/b]
Requirements: Content Patcher 
Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu

This mod adds NPC's favorite fish to Willy's fish shop. If an NPC does not have a loved fish, Willy will sell fish required for their loved dish. You can choose to have the dishes for sale by year (default) or the season of the NPC's birthday.
Optional Dialogue for Willy regarding NPC's loved fish and birthday.  Optional increase on items Willy will buy.

Willy (spring 9) //Catfish, Octopus, Sea Cucumber and Sturgeon
Vincent (spring 10) //Snail 
Pierre (Spring 26) //Squid for Fried Calamari
Gus (summer 8) //Snail for Escargot & Tuna for Fish Tacos
Alex (Summer 13) //Salmon for Salmon Dinner
Dwarf (summer 22) //Lava Eel
Penny (Fall 2)  //Sandfish and Shrimp for Tom Kha Soup  
Elliott (Fall 5) //Crab for Crabcakes, Lobster and Shrimp for Tom Kha Soup      
Jodi (fall 11) // Largemouth Bass for Crispy Bass & Eel for Fried Eel       
Abigail (fall 13) //Pupperfish and Eel for Spicy Eel                          
Linus (winter 3) //Sardine for Dish O' the Sea       
Caroline (winter 7) //Tuna for Fish Tacos
Sebastian (Winter 10) //any fish for Sashimi   
Wizard (winter 17) //Super Cucumber
******
Any NPC not listed above does not have a loved fish and/or dish.

[b]Insulation
[/b]1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract the Generic Mod Config Menu mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. (optional but recommended)
4. Download and Extract Willy sells Loved Fish into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
5. Launch Stardew Valley. To enable the settings you want, click the cog wheel on the bottom left of the Stardew Valley title screen.
